title: Exact Degeneracy Under Balanced k-Shot Sampling:Consequences for Small-Sample Discriminant Analysis on LLM Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2609.09860v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Balanced k-shot sampling, drawing exactly k labeled examples per class, is the standard protocol in few-shot evaluation. We show that it induces an exact degeneracy in Kernelized Linear Principal Component Discriminant Analysis (KLPCDA), a family of seven supervised dimensionality reduction methods. The within-class operator becomes exactly a scaled orthogonal projector, so two variants have all signal eigenvalues equal and a third has a zero operator, and the truncated pseudo-inverse used to implement them removes exactly the subspace that contains all between-class information. We verify this to float64 precision on sentence embeddings and on residual-stream activations of a decoder-only model, and find that the accuracies of the truncated variants change with the number of BLAS threads, by up to 12 percentage points (57 for the variant with a zero operator). translated_title: 平衡k-shot采样下的精确简并：对LLM嵌入上小样本判别分析的影响
translated_abstract: 平衡k-shot采样（即每类恰好抽取k个带标签样本）是少样本评估的标准协议。我们证明，它会在核化线性主成分判别分析（KLPCDA）——一族包含七种方法的有监督降维方法——中引发精确的数学简并：类内算子恰好变成一个缩放正交投影算子，因此其中两个变体的所有信号特征值完全相等，而第三个变体的算子为零；此外，实现这些方法时所使用的截断伪逆恰好移除了包含全部类间信息的子空间。我们在句子嵌入以及仅解码器模型的残差流激活上以float64精度验证了这一结论，并发现截断变体的准确率会随BLAS线程数而变化，波动幅度最高达12个百分点（对于算子为零的变体高达57个百分点）。若用支持集内选取的岭正则化替代截断，（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明平衡k-shot采样会使KLPCDA中的判别分析方法发生精确的数学简并，其截断伪逆恰好抹除了全部类间信息子空间，导致准确率对BLAS线程数等数值实现细节异常敏感（波动可达12至57个百分点），而以岭正则化替代截断可消除该简并。
en_tdlr: Balanced k-shot sampling induces an exact degeneracy in KLPCDA, where the truncated pseudo-inverse removes the entire between-class information subspace, making accuracies highly sensitive to numerical implementation details such as BLAS thread count (up to 12–57 percentage points), and replacing the truncation with a ridge selected within the support set resolves this degeneracy.
